summary:
Iteration 3 verifies NEW features (per-source config, advertising slots, cron endpoint, .emergent/crons.yml) + regression. 14/14 backend pytest cases PASS and Playwright UI smoke PASS. Admin /admin (Basic admin/admin123) renders ads-table + ad-form (data-testids: ad-form, ad-position, ad-kind, ad-title, ad-link, ad-image, ad-snippet, ad-save) and 4 cfg- forms with 3 save-cfg- buttons (demo intentionally has no save button). POST /admin/source/config with slug=upornia_csv&feed_url=... persists into sources.config JSON and is visible in the input on subsequent /admin GET. POST /admin/ads/save creates ads: banner (home_top) renders
on /; snippet with
hi
renders raw HTML unescaped inside ad-home_middle; video_pre + video_sidebar render on /video/{slug}. POST /admin/ads/delete redirects with flash 'Ad deleted'. Cron endpoint POST /api/cron/nightly-import: no auth => 401, wrong Bearer => 401, correct Bearer (from backend/.env WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET) => 200 with {ok:true,event:'nightly-import-accepted'} and background imports triggered (demo excluded). /app/.emergent/crons.yml exists with single 'nightly-import' entry, cron '0 3 * * *', endpoint contains /api/cron/nightly-import. Regression: /api/health ok, home renders Featured/Popular, /videos?sort=newest 200, /sitemap.xml emits public host, age-gate hidden after confirm with localStorage davisporn_age_ok=1.
critical_code_review_comments: Ad::forPosition uses ORDER BY weight DESC, RAND() LIMIT 1 — only the highest-weight ad renders per slot. If multiple ads share a position they silently starve. Consider surfacing this on admin UI (e.g., 'currently winning' badge).

AdminController::saveAd trusts snippet_html verbatim (rendered without escape). This is intentional (self-managed admin trusts itself) but there is NO CSRF protection on /admin/* POST routes — Basic-auth session is browser-cached, so a malicious cross-origin form could POST /admin/ads/save with a script snippet and inject stored XSS into every page. Add a CSRF token or SameSite=Strict cookie check.

AdminController::saveSourceConfig merges values but empty submissions overwrite existing keys with '' (loop at line 49). For xnxx_rapidapi, saving feed_url alone will silently blank api_key/host. Consider only writing keys that are present in the POST body.

CronController::nightlyImport uses fastcgi_finish_request when available but PHP is served via built-in server here (function does NOT exist), so it falls back to flush()+ignore_user_abort. In practice the client got 200 fast enough during test, but under load the dispatcher may block up to import duration. Fine for cron but worth documenting.

Home canonical link is <link rel=canonical href='https://127.0.0.1:9000/'> — SEO regression relative to sitemap fix. SeoController path was fixed to use X-Forwarded-Host but the layout that emits <link rel=canonical> still uses the raw server host. Low severity but visible in every page.
test_credentials: Admin Basic: admin/admin123. Cron Bearer: 4cbe7eb9011e833001687088c1ecc98523615151403a55e8 (from /app/backend/.env WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET).
seed_data_creation: Test creates several TEST_/DBG_ ads across home_top, home_middle, video_pre, video_sidebar; test_delete_ad_and_flash removes the first ad shown in admin table. No cleanup of remaining test ads (safe — admin can delete manually). No videos/sources created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter3 features working. Note: (a) home_top slot may render 'DBG_HOMETOP' from previous seed run because weight=99 > any newer test ad's weight — this is by-design ORDER BY weight DESC. (b) Canonical URL still uses server host (minor SEO). (c) No CSRF on /admin POST endpoints. (d) saveSourceConfig blanks fields not sent in the same form — verify before writing multi-field configs. Full pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py can be re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py -v`.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues in this iteration. During test authoring a false-positive failure was caused by asserting a specific ad title rendered in home_top; because Ad::forPosition orders by weight DESC, a higher-weight ad from a previous run wins the LIMIT 1 slot. Assertion relaxed to slot-presence, which is the actual invariant.
